title: Ranger's Letter
wikitext:
The '''Ranger's Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Ranger's Letter (quest)|Ranger's Letter|race=HighElf|class=hunter}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Greetings, <name>!

My name is Rubinah Sunsworn! I have watched your exploits with interest. You are a fine ranger, but the loss of our homeland has left your training incomplete.

Twenty years ago, during the Second War, the Farstriders planted a seed from our homeland outside of the lodge. Now, that tree is more than a reminder. It is hope that our home may one day be reclaimed.

It is the job of all rangers to defend our people wherever they live.

I will be able to continue your training. Come speak to me within the lodge when you’re ready.
}}
